title: Get User Account Timeline — get_account_timeline
text: username character; name account X without "@" symbol. max_results numeric; number posts per API call, 10 100. function stops request value outside range. max_posts posts read call. API bills every post returns (US$0.005 September 2026), function prints cap posts dollars first request. last page trimmed result never holds many posts. end_time latest date-time want get posts. Provide value ISO 8601 format (.e., YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ). iso_8601() function convert string, date, date-time object required format (e.g., iso_8601("2024-10-10")). start_time earliest date-time want get posts. until_id post ID limit results posts older specified ID. since_id post ID limit results posts recent specified ID. pagination_token string used navigate backward result pages. X API provides token results available. Typically, won’t need set manually function handles , can supply pagination_token previous response continue retrieving results beyond last page, desired. exclude comma-separated list types posts exclude response (e.g., "retweets", "replies", "retweets,replies"). sleep_time Seconds pause pages. Rate limits handled : 429 5xx response retried three times, waiting long API asks. error stops API's message, mistyped handle bad token fails seconds. post_fields character, vector; fields return post. default asks everything twelve tables need: c("created_at", "text", "note_tweet", "article", "public_metrics",   "geo", "attachments", "context_annotations", "entities", "lang",   "possibly_sensitive", "edit_controls", "referenced_tweets",   "reply_settings", "conversation_id", "in_reply_to_user_id", "author_id",   "edit_history_tweet_ids", "id"). Fields free; posts cost, nothing save trimming . user_fields character, vector; fields return user. Default: c("created_at", "description", "protected",   "entities", "location", "profile_image_url", "public_metrics",   "verified", "verified_type", "is_identity_verified", "url"). media_fields character, vector; fields return media item. Default: c("duration_ms", "height", "width",   "preview_image_url", "type", "url", "alt_text", "public_metrics",   "variants", "media_key"). poll_fields character, vector; fields return poll. Default: c("end_datetime", "duration_minutes",   "options", "voting_status", "id"). place_fields character, vector; fields return tagged place. Default: c("country", "country_code",   "full_name", "geo", "id", "place_type"). expansions character, vector; related objects return alongside post. Default: c("author_id",   "entities.mentions.username", "referenced_tweets.id.author_id",   "referenced_tweets.id", "in_reply_to_user_id", "attachments.media_keys",   "attachments.poll_ids", "geo.place_id"). Expansions free.

Adding bearer token .Renviron file keeps scripts available every session. post_fields character, vector; fields return post. default asks everything twelve tables need: c("created_at", "text", "note_tweet", "article", "public_metrics",   "geo", "attachments", "context_annotations", "entities", "lang",   "possibly_sensitive", "edit_controls", "referenced_tweets",   "reply_settings", "conversation_id", "in_reply_to_user_id", "author_id",   "edit_history_tweet_ids", "id"). Fields free; posts cost, nothing save trimming . user_fields character, vector; fields return user. Default: c("created_at", "description", "protected",   "entities", "location", "profile_image_url", "public_metrics",   "verified", "verified_type", "is_identity_verified", "url"). media_fields character, vector; fields return media item. Default: c("duration_ms", "height", "width",   "preview_image_url", "type", "url", "alt_text", "public_metrics",   "variants", "media_key"). poll_fields character, vector; fields return poll. Default: c("end_datetime", "duration_minutes",   "options", "voting_status", "id"). place_fields character, vector; fields return tagged place. Default: c("country", "country_code",   "full_name", "geo", "id", "place_type"). expansions character, vector; related objects return alongside post. Default: c("author_id",   "entities.mentions.username", "referenced_tweets.id.author_id",   "referenced_tweets.id", "in_reply_to_user_id", "attachments.media_keys",   "attachments.poll_ids", "geo.place_id"). Expansions free.

title: xapir 0.1.0
text: Long posts longer cut . X returns posts 280 characters short text full text note_tweet. extract_post() now puts full text text marks row is_long_post = TRUE. one text column, whole post. One row per post. post appeared one page’s data another page’s includes used come back twice, post replied quoted came back twice . fixed. Thread labels cleaner result. post_url carries author’s handle: https://x.com/<username>/status/<post_id>. author response, falls back https://x.com//web/status/<post_id>, X also resolves. Reposts keep impression_count. like_count, reply_count, quote_count, bookmark_count repost_count NA, numbers belong original post. New columns: lang, possibly_sensitive, article_title timeline holds X article. created_at UTC default, extract_user(). Convert lubridate::with_tz() want local time, pass tz = Sys.timezone().

text: extract_user() adds is_identity_verified url (profile link API sends ; link_in_bio still display form). extract_post_media() adds alt_text. extract_post_edited_post_id() longer lists every post edit . row now means post edited. extract_post_poll_option() finds polls quoted posts , never returns row NA post_id.

title: xapir 0.1.0
text: Every posts reader asks fields default, including note_tweet, article, edit_controls, possibly_sensitive, is_identity_verified, url, alt_text geo.place_id expansion. Pass max_posts change . endless retries. rate limit (429) server error (5xx) retried three times, waiting long X asks. Anything else, bad token misspelled handle, stops seconds X’s message. max_results must 10 100, function tells spends anything. get_recent_post() never returns posts max_posts. get_mentions() exported: posts name account, since_id appending new. get_account_timeline() get_bookmark() exported names ; three used hidden behind duplicate get_timeline() definition.
